hook_text: Seven years here and never looked up

song.title: Hello Street
song.style: English, sunny jangly indie pop, chiming electric guitar, tambourine, bright bass, warm friendly male lead vocal, slightly raspy, 124 BPM
song.lyrics:
[Verse]
Lived on this street for seven years
Never looked up past my nose
Slid my phone in its orange coat
Lifted my chin and there it goes

[Chorus]
Who painted that? Who's that cat?
When did the trees get tall like that?
Closed its eyes, I opened mine
Hello street, you're looking fine

shots.prompt: {moss} shuffles down a street with his head bent low over his cupped hands and bonks his head on a lamppost. Static medium shot. Flat grey light.
{moss} rubs his head and stares down at his feet on the sidewalk, sighing. Static close-up. Grey light.

A hand gently slides a black smartphone all the way down into a slim terracotta-orange sleeve standing upright on a soft cream studio backdrop, until the phone disappears inside and only the rounded thumb notch at the top remains. A small closed-eye emblem is pressed into the front of the sleeve. The hand pulls away and the sleeve stands still, casting a soft shadow. Static close-up, the light slowly turns warmer.
{moss} slowly lifts his chin and his eyes go wide behind his round glasses as color floods the street around him. The camera pushes in. Light warming to bright gold.
{moss} gasps and points at a huge colourful mural of a smiling sun painted on a brick wall. Static wide shot. Bright saturated colours.
{moss} waves at a fluffy orange cat on a windowsill, and the cat slowly blinks back. Static medium shot. Warm sunlight.
{moss} tilts his head way back to look up at tall green trees arching over the street. Low angle, the camera tilts up. Dappled sunlight.
{moss} closes his eyes and breathes in the sunshine, smiling, his raincoat fluttering in the breeze. Static close-up. Warm golden light.
{moss} shakes hands with a neighbour over a garden gate and they both burst out laughing. The camera slowly pulls back. Peach sunset light, calm.

caption: Moss gave his phone an Eyelid and met his street for the first time in seven years. The cat was there the whole time.
